assets.title: Wind Load, Branch Leverage & Support
assets.purpose: Show how canopy area, branch length, flower mass, gust direction and tie/support positions change mechanical load.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps identify vulnerable long unsupported branches and load concentration before failure.

assets.title: Stake, Cage & Trellis — Load Distribution Comparison
assets.purpose: Compare support methods by where they carry load, how they expand with growth and where failure/contact points can develop.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows that a strong support can still damage stems when load is concentrated or geometry is poor.

assets.title: Flexible Tie vs Girdling Tie
assets.purpose: Show correct flexible support contact beside constriction, abrasion and stem expansion problems.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps users distinguish support injury from disease lesions or random stem damage.

assets.title: Canopy Architecture — Wind & Drying Tradeoffs
assets.purpose: Show how dense walls, branch overlap, pruning and support geometry influence wind load and post-rain drying simultaneously.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps explain why a sheltered canopy can reduce wind damage yet retain humidity or wetness.

assets.title: Storm Damage Differential — Wind, Hail, Chewing & Abrasion
assets.purpose: Compare branch tearing, hail impact, wind abrasion/rubbing and chewing damage using realistic tissue patterns.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents mechanical weather injury from being misidentified as pest feeding or disease.

assets.title: Post-Storm Structural Inspection
assets.purpose: Guide a repeatable inspection from anchorage and main stem through branch unions, ties, trellis, flower load and hidden rubbing damage.
assets.diagnosticUse: Finds structural damage before later wilting or branch failure obscures the original cause.
